checks.name: All seven empty components and 28 independent configurations render without mutating caller data
Duplicate person numbers and duplicate IDs are rejected
Student grade configuration excludes others and all unannounced grade history
Published zero values are preserved for the current student
Assignments reject duplicate active teaching relationship and primary conflict
Assignment terms, inactive teachers, and class scope are checked before saving
Practice dependency cycles and unknown material references are rejected
Learning dependency cycles, duplicate resources, invalid record positions are rejected
Resource version numbers are immutable unique positive integers and links are safe
Student resource configuration removes drafts, unavailable and expired contents
Text version comparisons reflect actual changed and added lines
Survey answer validation preserves false and zero ratings and enforces required responses
Survey maximum choices and unknown choice IDs are rejected
Survey raw responses are stripped for students and aggregate values survive repeated sanitization
Unreleased survey aggregates remain unavailable and empty means remain null
Grades distinguish null, zero, absence, and explicitly exempt values
Point grades renormalize allowed exemptions and reject invalid total weights
Unsupported roles, invalid time windows and unsafe identifiers fail explicitly
All authored labels and bodies are escaped before insertion into HTML

scope: Business rules, configuration validation, privacy boundaries and public renderer only; DOM interactions separately tested
